Interface EntityDecoder<A>

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface EntityDecoder<A>
How to read an A from a body: a type class, so User u = req.as(); finds the decoder for User at compile time.

Decoding blocks while it reads the body, which is fine on a request's virtual thread. A body that can't be decoded throws DecodeFailure, which the errors middleware answers with a 400 (or 415) problem response.
